purpose: Reconciles a tokenized-securities omnibus token position against caller-declared state: it sums the balances of every declared wallet, computes the omnibus-versus-wallets and omnibus-versus-book-entry deltas, chains a SHA-256 log head over the declared mint, burn, forced-transfer and transfer events in sequence order, counts forced transfers, and returns a RECONCILED / MISMATCH / UNDECIDABLE verdict within a declared integer tolerance. Venue-neutral arithmetic with two profiles: dtc_dts applies the registered-wallet rule from the pinned no-action letter (tokens are only transferable to Registered Wallets, so an unregistered wallet holding a balance is flagged and forces MISMATCH, never dropped from the sum), generic_omnibus runs the same sums without that rule. All inputs are caller-asserted aggregates under opaque labels: integer base units as decimal strings only, floats refused, negative balances refused, identifier-shaped labels (email, LEI, IBAN, long digit runs) refused and never echoed. Honest scope: this proves the arithmetic over the balances you declared. It does not read any ledger, queries nothing, and does not prove the balances are real.
